Data Description

The main data we use is the National Fixed Point Survey (NPFS), which is a nationally representative panel
dataset (unbalanced) of roughly 5000 households in 88 villages between 1995 and 2002. It is collected by the
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of China. It’s a panel of household surveys consists of over 5000
households that provide information on landholding, input, output, consumption, etc.
